mapper.sql: id, title, description, cover_image, instructor_id, category, difficulty, total_hours, status, completion_threshold, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (title, description, cover_image, instructor_id, category, difficulty, total_hours, status, completion_threshold, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, #{instructorId}, #{category}, #{difficulty}, #{totalHours}, #{status}, #{completionThreshold}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
